name: Nami
source:
Age: ???
Likes: Flowers, History, Maya
Doesn’t like: Inquisitive questions

Maya’s elder sister and instructor in the Flower Dragon school of magic. Nami’s habit of wielding very powerful magic to do seemingly trivial chores has always fascinated her little sister.

Well-versed in history, Nami sometimes talks of events of the far past as if she had firsthand experienced them. Her own life story is somewhat of a mystery even to Maya.

    “The legend tells that these flowers increased by the same number as there were casualties in the Great War.”

[From [url=https://arcusplume.com/twin-blue-moons/characters/nami/]official website[/url]]
